name: LlamaIndex PropertyGraphIndex
tier_reason: Widely used GraphRAG framework and de-facto Python integration layer over many graph stores
members: PropertyGraphStore integrations (Neo4j, Memgraph, FalkorDB, Neptune, Nebula, TiDB, Kuzu)
release_cadence: Frequent (core and integrations bumped multiple times per quarter; exact cadence UNVERIFIED)
redistribution_notes: Library is MIT and OEM/embedding friendly; server-side graph stores it connects to carry their own licences (Neo4j, Memgraph, FalkorDB) and need separate review.
legal_review_reason: Not for the library itself; for the graph-store servers it targets (GPL/BSL/SSPL-class) and for the transitive dependency tree (SBOM scan not done).
community_vs_enterprise: Framework is fully open; commercial LlamaCloud/LlamaParse are separate and not required for PropertyGraphIndex.
resolution_note: Supersedes older KnowledgeGraphIndex. Kuzu store last released 2025-09-08 and upstream Kuzu reported archived 2025-10-10 (not re-verified): treat as orphaned risk. Guide table lists only Simple, Neo4j, Nebula, TiDB, FalkorDB but PyPI has Memgraph, Neptune, Kuzu packages.
decision_summary: REUSE patterns (schema-strict extraction, parameter-filling CypherTemplate); EXPERIMENT with seed-by-synonym/vector retrieval strategy; BUILD typed-plan NL query and ACL/tenancy (absent upstream); REJECT unguarded Text2Cypher in production.

name: OpenSPG / KAG
tier_reason: Schema-governed GraphRAG with logical-form reasoning from Ant Group; closest GraphRAG family member to EOIP's ontology-first stance
owner: Ant Group (OpenSPG / Knowledge Engine team) with OpenKG community
release_cadence: 5 releases Nov 2024 - Jun 2025; none since v0.8.0 (about 16 months); sparse commits (one seen 2026-01-28)
license: Apache-2.0 (KAG, OpenSPG, KAG-Thinker repo); PyPI metadata empty; KAG-Thinker weight licence NOT PUBLICLY VERIFIED
redistribution_notes: Apache-2.0 code with patent grant; required/typical dependencies (Neo4j, Elasticsearch, relational DB) and model weights (Qwen2.5 base) carry separate terms.
legal_review_reason: Dependency licences (Neo4j Community GPLv3, optional Elasticsearch), model-weight licence, and possible Ant Group patents (NOT PUBLICLY VERIFIED).
community_vs_enterprise: No enterprise edition found in sources read; Ant Group internal deployments are not public.
resolution_note: Two repos: OpenSPG/openspg (engine) and OpenSPG/KAG (framework); SPG = Semantic-enhanced Programmable Graph; KAG-Thinker is a separate repo. Activity is slowing: treat as maintenance-pace until a newer release appears.
action_reason: Assigned Tier A entry, verified; status set to maintenance because of release gap.
decision_summary: EXPERIMENT as isolated sidecar for evaluation; BUILD typed plan-and-operator reasoning natively; REUSE schema-constrained extraction pattern; REJECT OpenSPG as storage authority (backend neutrality, one-node first).

sources.title: KAG: Boosting LLMs in Professional Domains via Knowledge Augmented Generation (arXiv:2409.13731)
